{{Quote|Approach. I am Bay-Yon Siu, of the Sanej Temple.|Bay-Yon Siu|<ref name="WDA" />}}
'''Bay-Yon Siu''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Sanej Temple]] whose personality was embedded in a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. The holocron ended up in the [[Tularan Marsh]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when Siu began teaching the [[nekghoul]]s the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
